description.value: Green Lettuce is Vancouver's first Indian-style Chinese food restaurant, a homestyle Kingsway institution established in 1999 that melds traditional Chinese technique with Indian spices. The late food critic James Barber was a devoted fan, and the restaurant has attracted Bollywood celebrities including Hrithik Roshan and Aishwarya Rai. The Vancouver location seats 60 people and offers a broad menu spanning chilli dumplings, Manchurian chicken, paneer, and gluten-free rice-noodle dishes.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Vancouver phone (604-876-9883) and corroborates the restaurant as a real, active Indian-Chinese fusion establishment. A material address discrepancy exists: OSM records 1449 Kingsway while the website's Vancouver Menu and Locations & Hours pages both state 1949 Kingsway — the website value is used per rule 12. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags; the FAQ explicitly confirms vegetarian and gluten-free options.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records 1449 Kingsway but the website Vancouver Menu and Locations & Hours pages both consistently state 1949 Kingsway — website value used; physical address requires verification before publishing.
Postal code V5N 2T1 sourced from OSM and may not correspond to 1949 Kingsway; should be verified alongside the corrected street number.
Website contains contradictory delivery information: FAQ states 'We do not offer delivery at this time' while the front page directs customers to DoorDash for delivery orders — FAQ may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, long-established restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor, but the street number discrepancy (OSM: 1449 vs website: 1949 Kingsway) must be resolved before publishing. Bike parking and washrooms are unconfirmed.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms vegetarian dishes (paneer, tofu, vegetable dishes) and explicitly lists gluten-free options including vermicelli (rice noodles), paneer, and many vegetarian dishes
